task.description: Produce a Type E prose design at src/design/iss0181-gh512-t010-migration.md that retires the 184 baselined T010 hardcoded-UUID BLOCKERs by substituting TestHarness.newUuid()/newUuidString(allocator) at CONVERT sites and retaining the 13 platform-admin user_id literals with auditable per-entry comments. Do NOT modify any source code in this turn.
acceptance_criteria: Design covers goal/scope, substitution rules (S1-S4), retention rules (R1-R3), 5-batch migration order, helper-API analysis (none added), validation criteria, risks/edge cases, and effort estimate
Design correctly maps the 171 CONVERT and 13 RETAIN counts from the diagnosis
Design identifies the platform-admin user_id UUID as the only RETAIN literal and lists all 13 file/line locations
Design documents the 'try h.newUuidString(alloc); defer alloc.free(slice);' allocation pattern from helpers.zig
Design flags the defer ordering risk in event_store_integration_test.zig (cleanupInstance defer vs alloc.free defer)
Design requires zero production code change and zero migration change

result.summary: Designed the 184-T010 retirement at src/design/iss0181-gh512-t010-migration.md (Type E prose). 171 CONVERT sites routed through substitution rules S1 (bpm.uuid.Uuid value, allocation-free via newUuid()) and S2 (heap-allocated string via newUuidString(allocator) with defer alloc.free); S3 collapses to S2 (no file-scope shared literals); S4 defers to R3 retention. 13 RETAIN sites are all the conventional platform-admin user_id 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001 with a '// GH-512 retention:' comment added above each. 5-batch migration order: Batch 1 event_store_integration_test.zig (59 sites, biggest early signal), Batch 2 high-volume (40 sites), Batch 3 medium (37 sites), Batch 4 small (32 sites), Batch 5 edge-case verification. No TestHarness API additions required. Validation criteria: linter T010 drops 184→13, baseline shrinks 225→54 with 0 new entries, zig build test exit 0, pre-existing failures (#482/479/427/424/423/418/417) not regressed, no error.SkipZigTest added. Effort: 130 minutes total, surface area medium, difficulty Standard(3). No source files modified.
